title: dev/check_function_signatures: diff against an explicit --base-revision (HEAD^1 in PR CI) instead of fetching the base branch and using merge-base
answers: Function-signature lint fails in PR CI with a missing merge base or unknown revision, even though the PR itself is fine
How does the function-signature check choose which commit to compare against?
Where is the base revision for the signature check set in the lint workflow?
I want to run the signature compatibility check locally against a different branch or commit; which flag do I pass?
body:
Path: The breaking-change check for Python function signatures in dev/ takes a base revision and lists changed files with `git diff --name-only BASE HEAD`, then reads each file's old version with `git show BASE:path`. Chokepoints are dev/check_function_signatures.py:get_changed_python_files, get_file_content_at_revision, compare_signatures and parse_args (`--base-revision`). Lint workflow passes the value from .github/workflows/lint.yml.
Rule: Pass an explicit revision rather than relying on fetch depth or `base...HEAD` merge-base discovery. PR CI runs `--base-revision HEAD^1` (the first parent of the synthetic merge commit), and checkout uses `fetch-depth: 2`. The earlier `git fetch origin master:master` step and the `base...HEAD` diff were removed in dev/check_function_signatures.py:get_changed_python_files.
Symptom: Signature lint depended on a base branch being present locally at a sufficient history depth; a fetch depth of 300 did not guarantee the merge base existed, so the check could fail on PR CI for reasons unrelated to the change.
Constraints: The check only runs in PR context (`github.event_name == 'pull_request'` on the Ubuntu lint job). Local invocation with no flag defaults to `GITHUB_BASE_REF` or `master`, and that ref must already exist locally because no fetch happens. Use `--base-revision <rev>` to compare against any other commit or branch.
applies: Developer lint tooling in dev/check_function_signatures.py and its CI wiring in .github/workflows/lint.yml; not runtime mlflow/ package code.
says: Pull request compatibility check fails with missing git revision errors on valid changes.
Automated pull request checks fail unexpectedly when comparing changes against the target branch.
Function compatibility verification crashes in automated pull request validation due to shallow history.
Allow running API signature validation locally against any specific commit or branch.
Ensure pull request checks pass reliably without requiring complete git repository history.
search: Developer function-signature linting in dev/check_function_signatures.py compares changes against an explicit --base-revision flag passed to git diff and git show instead of fetching base branches or computing merge bases. In .github/workflows/lint.yml, pull request CI runs with --base-revision HEAD^1 and fetch-depth: 2 to prevent failures when commit history lacks the merge base. Applies strictly to pull request events on the Ubuntu lint job and local checks defaulting to GITHUB_BASE_REF or master, not to runtime mlflow package code.
